scope: P5.2 diagnostic selection; not complete cost acceptance. User selected Podman.
selection: Retain candidate only if both payloads on all-volume have 4/4 nondecreasing paired throughput, median throughput ratio >= 1.05, and median p95 ratio <= 1, with no correctness error. Otherwise restore original P5 store.ts. Five percent is an engineering decision, not significance.
order: Rotate layouts each block; reverse sizes on odd blocks; adjacent source order balanced AB/BA per cell.
mechanism: All five diagnostics use the same config/data directory symlinks and explicit existing Durable path override. Split layouts are not a supported backup topology. No TypeScript instrumentation. Actual open DB paths and mount metadata verified outside timers.
limits: One-variable contrasts do not estimate all storage interactions. Warm 250 ms outbox ceiling can mask smaller code benefits. No power-loss or production SLO claim.
finalTarget: Separate complete named-volume deployment: artifacts AND normal namespace stored on Podman local volume; release tool inputs remain bind-mounted. Only environment.storage changes in derived protocol; all workload/budget fields unchanged.
